newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stocks end week firmer in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stocks end week firmer in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwe industrial shares closed the week firmer, riding high on the back of gains in several counters.
Brokers said the current fundamentals pointed to continued strength on the bourse in the coming week.
"I'm expecting the market to continue strong. All the good news is still out there....and most of the company results coming out now are pretty good," said one broker.
The main 57-counter industrial index added 14.21 points on Friday to scale a new all-time high of 10,674.03. It gained 666.61 points on the week.

Counters to advance included FMB which surged 500 cents to 7,000 while BAT put on 200 cents to 3,800. Zimpapers at 3,100 and Bicaf at 400 both went up 100 cents, Meikles added 75 cents to 2,375 and Caps was 50 cents up at 1,350.
Against the main trend, Barclays lost 200 cents to 3,800, Truworths shed 50 cents to 1100, Spinweave slid 20 cents down to 60 and Natfoods lost 25 cents to 605.
Minings continued generally weak and the secondary seven-share index there lost 43.97 points to 884.49. It slipped 1.21 points on the week.
